# `aitbc coin-requests show`

Show details of a specific coin transfer request.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc coin-requests show [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--request-id` | text | — | yes | The Request id. |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc coin-requests show --request-id <request_id>
```
